options.text: Buy from the first or the second shopkeeper as both are the same.

A cyclist travels 120 km in 3 hours, rests for 1 hour, and then travels another 80 km in 2 hours. To determine the cyclist's average speed for the entire journey, which of the following quantities should be used?

options.text: Distance travelled in a particular direction divided by time
Change in velocity divided by total time taken
Total displacement divided by total time taken
Total distance travelled divided by the total time taken

questions.key_answer: Total distance travelled divided by the total time taken
